name: MonarchMetric
title: Metric
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Column or FlowRow of androidx.compose.material3.Text, numbers written by android.icu.text.NumberFormat and CompactDecimalFormat (money by MonarchMoneyFormat); the change is a MonarchDeltaIndicator
summary: One number with its label, an optional unit and an optional change, formatted for the locale in tabular figures, with no surface around it.
whenToUse: For a key figure in a dashboard, a card, a toolbar or a table footer: "Open tickets 128 up 12%".
whenNotToUse: Not for an amount of money on its own: use MonarchMoney. Not for a tile with a chart and actions: put the metric in a MonarchWidget or a MonarchCard. Not for a number inside running text: use MonarchTabularNumber.
api: @Composable fun MonarchMetric(label: String, value: Double?, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, unit: String? = null, change: MonarchMetricChange? = null, format: MonarchMetricFormat = MonarchMetricFormat.Number, size: MonarchMetricSize = MonarchMetricSize.Md, layout: MonarchMetricLayout = MonarchMetricLayout.Stacked, alignment: Alignment.Horizontal = Alignment.Start, compact: Boolean = false, locale: Locale? = null, emptyLabel: String? = null)

@Composable fun MonarchMetric(label: String, text: String?, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, spokenText: String? = null, unit: String? = null, change: MonarchMetricChange? = null, size: MonarchMetricSize = MonarchMetricSize.Md, layout: MonarchMetricLayout = MonarchMetricLayout.Stacked, alignment: Alignment.Horizontal = Alignment.Start, emptyLabel: String? = null)

class MonarchMetricChange(value: Double?, comparison: String? = null, goodDirection: MonarchDeltaIndicatorGoodDirection = MonarchDeltaIndicatorGoodDirection.Up, variant: MonarchDeltaIndicatorVariant = MonarchDeltaIndicatorVariant.Plain, flatThreshold: Double = 0.0, formatValue: ((Double) -> String)? = null, icon: (@Composable (direction: MonarchDeltaIndicatorDirection) -> Unit)? = null) { companion object { fun between(current: Double?, previous: Double?, comparison: String? = null, goodDirection: …, variant: …, flatThreshold: Double = 0.0, formatValue: ((Double) -> String)? = null, icon: … = null): MonarchMetricChange } }
sealed class MonarchMetricFormat { abstract fun format(value: Double, compact: Boolean, locale: Locale): String; data object Number; data object Percent; data class Currency(val code: String) }
enum class MonarchMetricSize { Sm, Md, Lg }

options.name: label
options.description: What the number measures, such as "Open tickets". Always visible.

options.name: value
options.description: The number. null, NaN or infinity shows a dash that TalkBack reads as "No data".

options.name: text
options.description: In the second overload: the value already written by the app. null or empty shows the dash.

options.name: spokenText
options.description: In the second overload: what TalkBack reads instead of text.

options.name: unit
options.description: Written smaller and muted after the value. Hidden for an empty value.

options.name: change
options.description: The change against an earlier period, drawn by MonarchDeltaIndicator under the value (after it when inline). MonarchMetricChange(value) takes a ratio; MonarchMetricChange.between(current, previous) works it out.

options.name: format
options.description: Number, Percent (a ratio: 0.12 is 12%) or Currency(code).

options.name: size
options.description: Sm for dense rows, Md, Lg for a headline figure. Lg also draws the change one size larger.

options.name: layout
options.description: Stacked puts the label above the value; Inline puts label, value and change on one line that wraps.

options.name: alignment
options.description: The alignment of the stacked layout; Alignment.End for numeric columns.

options.name: compact
options.description: Writes 12K or €3.4M with the locale's compact notation; TalkBack reads the full value.

options.name: locale
options.description: The locale to write in. Default: the first locale of the configuration.

options.name: emptyLabel
options.description: Replaces the built-in "No data" read for a missing value (monarch_metric_empty).

states.name: default
states.description: The label in the muted text role, the value in the default text role with tabular figures, the unit muted, the change under it.

states.name: empty
states.description: A dash in the subtle text role instead of the value, read as "No data"; the unit is hidden.

states.name: compact
states.description: The value is written short (12K); its content description is the full number.

appearance: No surface. The label uses the muted text role, the value the default text role in the heading role (bodyStrong for Sm, display for Lg), the unit the muted text role, and the change the tones of MonarchDeltaIndicator. High-contrast themes resolve the same roles to stronger colors.
platformNotes: The web value accepts any React node and Intl.NumberFormat options; on Android a number is written by android.icu.text.NumberFormat (number, percent, compact) or MonarchMoneyFormat (currency) in the locale, and any other value is passed as text with an optional spoken form, as on iOS. The web align start/end is an Alignment.Horizontal. The web shows the full compact value as a hover title; Android has no hover on touch, so only TalkBack gets it. The change takes the main MonarchDeltaIndicator options; its flat and no-data labels keep their built-in text. iOS uses the same name and options.
accessibility: The metric is one TalkBack element (merged semantics): the label, the value with its unit and the change sentence of MonarchDeltaIndicator, for example "Latency, 840, ms, down 8% vs last week, better".
A compact value is read in full ("12,345"), and the dash for a missing value is read as "No data" or emptyLabel.
The change's meaning is carried by its sign, its arrow slot and the spoken sentence, not by color.
Text uses Monarch type roles, so it scales with the font size setting and wraps instead of being cut off.
edgeCases: A value that is not finite (infinity, NaN) is shown as empty.
Very long values and units wrap; the unit moves under the value when both do not fit.
Percent takes a ratio: pass 0.12 for 12%. The percent format has no compact form.
Currency digits follow the currency: JPY has none.
A metric is not tappable; put it in a MonarchCard with onClick for a tile that opens a detail screen.

examples.title: Number, unit and change
examples.template:
MonarchMetric(
    label = {{label}},
    value = {{value|double}},
    unit = {{unit}},
    change = MonarchMetricChange(
        value = {{change.value}},
        comparison = {{change.comparison}},
        goodDirection = MonarchDeltaIndicatorGoodDirection.{{change.goodDirection|pascal}},
    ),
)
examples.code:
MonarchMetric(
    label = "Median response",
    value = 182.0,
    unit = "ms",
    change = MonarchMetricChange(
        value = -0.08,
        comparison = "vs last week",
        goodDirection = MonarchDeltaIndicatorGoodDirection.Down,
    ),
)

examples.title: Currency, percent and a missing value
examples.code:
Column {
    MonarchMetric(label = "Revenue", value = 3_400_000.0, format = MonarchMetricFormat.Currency("EUR"), compact = true)
    MonarchMetric(
        label = "Conversion",
        value = 0.12,
        format = MonarchMetricFormat.Percent,
        layout = MonarchMetricLayout.Inline,
        change = MonarchMetricChange.between(current = 0.12, previous = 0.1),
    )
    MonarchMetric(label = "Errors", value = null, unit = "per hour")
}
